senses.gloss: m. (ארק, cmp. חרק; אדק, עדק, cmp. חדק) a perforated vessel, a sort of clepsydra used in sick rooms.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 104a:15">Erub. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>ומטיפין מארק</he> Mus. a. oth. (ed. <he>מיארק</he> read <he>מי א׳</he>, Ms. M. <cite ref="A03095"><he>אריך</he></cite>, indistinct, Ms. Oxf. <he>ארג</he>, Ar. <he>אדק</he> a. <cite ref="A03232"><he>ארק</he></cite>, v. Ar. ed. Koh.) you may, on the Sabbath, let water drip from the Arak for a sick person; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 10:13:3">Y. Erub. X, 26ᵈ</cite> top <he>מוסיפין בעדק</he> (<he>מטיפין</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 2:8">Tosef. Sabb. II, 8</cite> <he>מן אדק</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>האדק</he>).
